limitations: Active state uses observed event prefixes only; hidden ground truth is never read.
Unknown ETA, review, planning, pilot and occupancy durations use configured means.
Service windows not yet observed use request + mean travel + window tolerance.
Berth occupancy after recorded cargo start is assumed from the configured mean.
Berth occupation includes pilot approach and cargo service; targets apply to cargo start.
Review is non-preemptive within configured shifts; parallel review is not modeled.
Baseline preserves observed berth choices and configured reviewer capacity; missing choices are completed with FIFO. Closures apply to both sides.
Identical per-case random streams drive both plans, independent of execution order.
Review rework uses observable missing-document counts; up to three attempts.
Schedules show replication one; headline KPIs summarize every replication.
Resource queues prevent overlaps on both sides; zero conflicts may remain zero.
Variation intervals describe sampled outcomes, not confidence in real-world savings.
